status: Interactive buildless design prototype; workflow backend integrations pending

reference_preset.adaptation: Borrow compact layout and component patterns while retaining the selected Nest identity, Raven-derived tokens and IBM Plex fonts.

production_foundation.rule: Keep the existing workspace and aliases. Add only required Base UI components. Adapt template navigation to TanStack Router and Nest tokens. Do not initialize a replacement project or overwrite the Nest theme.

delivery_boundary: These patterns are implemented as HTML/CSS/JavaScript interactions in the existing design prototype. No React dependency install or production component port is claimed. Component mappings below are the implementation handoff.

implemented: Stable message DOM, role=log and additions-only announcements; preparation updates preserve existing transcript nodes.

Separate persistent composer, compact application-owned action card and expandable preparation trace.
Trace labels distinguish local fixtures from backend checks. Stop response stays separate from plan dismissal.
patterns.target: apps/web/src/routes/chat.tsx; shared chat presentation in apps/web/src/components

implemented: Shared density and column chooser for DeFi, RWA assets and venue market tables.
Identity stays visible during horizontal scrolling. Header stays visible inside a bounded table viewport.
10/25/50 page sizes for DeFi and RWA assets; page ranges and ranks follow the selected size.
Column preferences survive row rendering and route navigation within the session; required identity columns remain visible.
Existing source definitions, filters, sorting, exports and unavailable values are preserved.
Net value, gross assets, debt and coverage appear together.
Four restrained metrics lead into an allocation breakdown and existing positions/activity.
Asset mix and net-value controls switch views using the same labeled fixture accounting.
Wallet $8,260 + supply $10,000 + vault receipts $10,000 = assets $28,260; debt $3,500 gives net $24,760.
No fabricated price history or P&L. Cost basis remains unavailable; backing and collateral are not counted twice.
Unified amount groups attach units to decimal inputs and connect source/help descriptions.
Borrow invalid amounts show an inline field error, aria-invalid, associated error text and focus on the invalid field.
Existing exact-input comparison, quote refresh, source-derived Max requirements and withdrawal disclosures remain.
Compact controls and quieter borders reduce nesting without reducing touch targets.

behavior: Compare with Nest submits a read-only comparison prompt using the exact selected amount, asset and horizon.
Invalid or zero amounts stay in the form with an associated error and focus.
The comparison creates no financial action card and cannot sign or submit a transaction.
Selections persist during this page session and return when starting a new conversation.
Private amounts remain out of URLs. Production binds the comparison context to canonical network/asset identity and current source observations.
